huggingface.summary: We present Youtu-Parsing-Omni, an omni-modal parser that converts documents, images, audio, and video into structured records grounded in space and time, providing a perception layer for agents that read, locate, and cite evidence across modalities. huggingface.title: Proving and Improving the Platonic Representation Hypothesis with JEPAs
huggingface.summary: Whether models trained on different modalities converge to the same representation of the world is central to AI. huggingface.title: A-RSI: Adaptive Task Refresh for Zero-Data Multimodal Self-Improvement
huggingface.summary: Recursive self-improvement requires models not only to acquire useful training experience, but also to decide when their current experience has ceased to be useful. huggingface.title: Hy-Nomas: Towards Free-form Interactive World Generation

huggingface.title: LociArt: A Unified Paradigm for Free-Style Local Video Stylization

huggingface.title: VibeVideoBench: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Code-Driven Video Generation
huggingface.summary: Diffusion video models produce striking clips, but they cannot reliably render an exact formula, a correct chart, a rule-consistent game or narration synchronized to on-screen events. A different route is emerging: multimodal agents that write code to render every frame and synthesize every sound. We introduce VibeVideoBench, a benchmark for evaluating agents on code-driven video generation. huggingface.title: Can Discrete Tokens Serve as Semantically Lossless Representations of Visual Signals?
huggingface.summary: Discrete visual tokens represent vision in a discrete form analogous to language, offering a native interface for multimodal modeling under a shared next-token prediction objective. huggingface.summary: We present EmbeddingGemma 2, an open multimodal embedding model which natively represents text, images, audio, video, and combinations thereof in a unified space. huggingface.title: WorkFactory: Turning Professional Intents into Executable Work for Scalable Agent Training
huggingface.summary: Scaling supervised training for working agents requires diverse professional tasks that yield reliable expert demonstrations. However, missing or inconsistent task information can obstruct teacher execution and weaken the resulting supervision. huggingface.title: TAO: Tool-Aware Joint Scheduling for LLM-Based Agentic Serving
huggingface.summary: Agentic services alternate between model inference on clustered GPUs and external tools on distributed CPUs. In this scenario, existing systems (1) overlook tool-return readiness in service evaluation, wasting limited resources, and (2) use heuristic strategies to decide admission and placement on GPUs, resulting in suboptimal scheduling decisions. huggingface.title: Look Only When Needed: Certificate-Guided Visual Routing for Efficient Diffusion VLMs
huggingface.summary: Diffusion vision-language models (DVLMs) process their entire input at every denoising step. Since visual tokens make up 89-97% of this input on the benchmarks we study, most of the decoding computation is spent repeatedly processing the same image. Visual token pruning methods partially relieve this burden by removing part of the visual tokens, but they lose the removed information and still process the remaining image at every step. huggingface.title: StreamVibe: Proactive Video Agents for Evolving User Intent
huggingface.summary: Vision-language models are shifting from offline passive understanding toward online proactive interaction. However, prevailing methods largely rely on explicit requests while miss the implicit user intent (e.g., "where should I click next?" while a user navigate a website), meanwhile fail to update the state simultaneously as user requests might update continuously. huggingface.title: Work Agents: Systems, Capabilities, and Optimization
huggingface.summary: As foundation models evolve from information generation to digital work execution, agents are increasingly capable of completing complex tasks across tools, applications, and workflows. However, existing research lacks a unified perspective on how agents reliably accomplish delegated work. huggingface.title: Rollback: Experience Backtracking in World Models for Policy Improvement
huggingface.summary: Action-conditioned world models offer a scalable alternative to costly real-world interaction for improving robot policies. However, existing world-model-based methods largely treat world models as forward-only surrogates of the physical environment, leaving untapped a capability no physical environment affords: rewinding to past decision points to explore counterfactual futures.
